import matplotlib

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import numpy as np
import json

    raw = json.load(f)

data = raw['model_benchmarks']['data']
dims = raw['model_benchmarks']['dimensions']

family_colors = {
    'GPT': '#2563EB',
    'Claude': '#7C3AED',
    'Gemini': '#16A34A',
    'LLaMA': '#EA580C',
    'Qwen': '#DC2626',
}

# Identify top models: average score >= 85
def avg_score(m):
    return np.mean([m[d] for d in dims])

top_threshold = 85
top_models = {m['model'] for m in data if avg_score(m) >= top_threshold}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 9))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

n_dims = len(dims)
x = np.arange(n_dims)

# Draw vertical axes
for i in x:
    ax.axvline(i, color='#CCCCCC', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
    for tick in range(0, 101, 20):
        ax.plot(i, tick, '_', color='#999999', markersize=6, zorder=1)
        if i == 0:
            ax.text(i - 0.08, tick, str(tick), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7, color='#666666')

# Draw polylines - background models first, then top models
sorted_data = sorted(data, key=lambda m: m['model'] in top_models)

for m in sorted_data:
    vals = [m[d] for d in dims]
    is_top = m['model'] in top_models
    color = family_colors[m['family']]
    lw = 3.0 if is_top else 1.3
    alpha = 0.95 if is_top else 0.4
    zorder = 10 if is_top else 5

    ax.plot(x, vals, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder, solid_capstyle='round')

    if is_top:
        # Label at rightmost axis
        ax.annotate(m['model'], (x[-1], vals[-1]), xytext=(6, 0),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
                    color=color, va='center', zorder=15)

# Highlight crossing zones
# Reasoning-Speed crossing
rx = [dims.index('Reasoning'), dims.index('Inference Speed')]
ax.axvspan(min(rx) - 0.15, max(rx) + 0.15, alpha=0.06, color='#EF4444', zorder=0)
ax.text(np.mean(rx), 2, 'Reasoning ↔ Speed tradeoff', ha='center', fontsize=7,
        fontstyle='italic', color='#B91C1C', zorder=1)

# Multimodal-Math divergence
mx = [dims.index('Multimodal Understanding'), dims.index('Math / Quantitative')]
ax.axvspan(min(mx) - 0.15, max(mx) + 0.15, alpha=0.06, color='#3B82F6', zorder=0)
ax.text(np.mean(mx), 2, 'Multimodal ↔ Math divergence', ha='center', fontsize=7,
        fontstyle='italic', color='#1D4ED8', zorder=1)

# Axis labels

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(short_labels, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax.tick_params(axis='x', length=0, pad=8)

ax.set_ylim(-5, 108)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n_dims - 1 + 1.8)
ax.set_ylabel('Normalized Score (0–100)', fontsize=10, color='#444444', labelpad=10)
ax.yaxis.set_visible(False)
# Manual y-axis label
ax.text(-0.7, 50, 'Normalized Score (0–100)', rotation=90, ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=10, color='#444444')

# Legend
patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=f) for f, c in family_colors.items()]
patches.append(plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', linewidth=3, label='Top model (avg ≥ 85)'))
patches.append(plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.45, label='Other model'))
legend = ax.legend(handles=patches, loc='upper left', fontsize=8, frameon=True,
                   facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDDDDD', framealpha=0.95,
                   title='Model Family', title_fontsize=9)

ax.set_title('AI Model Capability Profiles — Parallel Coordinates',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=18)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
plt.close()
print('Done')

        fontweight='bold')

for m in top:

    # Glow effect
